name: ens_event_replay_val_v1
purpose: Event-level continuous replay of frozen M0 and ENS on all source-val cases. Internal test is locked (ens_internal_test_v1), so this is development-data evidence only.
population: all 555 source-val cases in causal_input_v1/cases, full original crop timeline, 20 ms grid
inference: every frame whose 150-frame history window has all rows input-valid; window transform identical to canonical_window (acc_norm recomputed, baro relative to window start, float32, source-train norm). Invalid windows produce no score; the stream is gap-flushed as in replay_m1_continuous.aggregate_scores

models.M0: M0 B best.pt (sha256 ac8596cd2e762a4b50845b79e312b1588e68956839a0e9c3573f88a05b5fc6cb), fault probability softmax[1]

event_policy: deployment OnlineDetectionPolicy defaults: inference_every 1, onset 0.6, clear 0.4, k_on 3, k_off 3, min_event 0.5 s, merge_gap 0.5 s; identical for both models, not tuned
reference_onset: first grid row with row_label_valid and reference_state == 1; normal cases have none

metrics.normal_false_events: finalized events lying entirely in label-valid normal time: independent-normal cases, and pre-onset part of fault cases, reported separately; count, per valid-exposure hour, alarm occupancy (fraction of valid normal time inside such events)
metrics.fault_detection: per fault case: detected if a confirmation has candidate_start >= onset; confirmation latency = confirmed_t - onset; also first finalized emission time and reason; cases with an event spanning the onset reported separately
metrics.breakdowns: by domain, flight directory, fault class

comparison: descriptive ENS vs M0, no pass/fail threshold (development data)
parity_checks: recomputed windows equal cache val x at cap64 starts; M0 scores at those windows equal saved source-val predictions (argmax)
